SELECT 
    t1.patkey, 
    MAX(t2.abkey) AS latest_assessment
FROM 
    patients AS t1
JOIN 
    assessmentbasics AS t2
ON 
    t1.patkey = t2.patownerref
GROUP BY 
    t1.patkey;

WITH latest_assessments AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.patkey, 
        MAX(t2.abkey) AS latest_assessment
    FROM 
        patients AS t1
    JOIN 
        assessmentbasics AS t2
    ON 
        t1.patkey = t2.patownerref
    GROUP BY 
        t1.patkey
)
SELECT 
    t1.patkey, 
    t3.suicrisk
FROM 
    latest_assessments AS t1
JOIN 
    assessmentbasics AS t2
ON 
    t1.latest_assessment = t2.abkey
JOIN 
    assessmentsymptomsandrisk AS t3
ON 
    t2.abkey = t3.asrkey;

parts.text:
I have identified the patients with the highest risk based on their latest assessment data. However, I am unable to update the database directly.

Here is the SQL code to add a column named 'high_priority' to the 'patients' table and update the records of patients who are identified as high-priority:

```sql
ALTER TABLE patients
ADD COLUMN high_priority BOOLEAN;

WITH latest_assessments AS (
    SELECT
        t1.patkey,
        MAX(t2.abkey) AS latest_assessment
    FROM
        patients AS t1
    JOIN
        assessmentbasics AS t2
    ON
        t1.patkey = t2.patownerref
    GROUP BY
        t1.patkey
)
UPDATE patients AS t1
SET high_priority = TRUE
FROM latest_assessments AS t2
JOIN assessmentbasics AS t3
ON t2.latest_assessment = t3.abkey
JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk AS t4
ON t3.abkey = t4.asrkey
WHERE t1.patkey = t2.patkey
AND t4.suicrisk IN ('High', 'Severe');
```
